name: KanbanCard
description: The default card content: title, a meta line, then badges and avatars at its foot. Use it inside `renderCard` to add slots.
signature: ({ title, meta, badges, avatars, children, className }: KanbanCardProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: avatars
props.description: People at the foot, end side: an AvatarGroup of assignees.

props.name: badges
props.description: Badges at the foot, start side: priority, type.

props.name: children
props.description: Anything else, between the meta line and the foot.

props.name: meta
props.description: A line of detail under it: an identifier, a requester, a due date.
